name: Oda Bultum University
location: Chiro, also known as Asebe Teferi
founded: Part of the public university expansion around 2015
distanceNote: An eastern trip on the Harar road corridor, a bit over 300 km from Addis.
knownFor: Serving West Hararghe as its main local public university option
A comprehensive but still developing range of applied and agriculture focused programs
A warmer, drier feel typical of eastern Oromia during the dry season
whatToExpect: As one of the newer universities in this list, facilities and program depth are still actively developing, ask current students in your specific department directly about their real experience rather than relying on the university's general description.

The moderate distance from Addis means holiday travel is manageable without being as easy as the closest universities on this list.
Sun protection is genuinely important for outdoor classes and activities given the region's typically warm, dry conditions.
tips: Confirm what resources and equipment your specific department actually has available before assuming, this varies given how recently the university was established.
